name: Fernbank Youth Interpreters (FYI) Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers staff interpretive carts that teach visitors about science, and help with museum programs for a full year. Training is provided.
who_can_apply: Teens at least 13 by September 1 and no older than 17 by June 1. Volunteers who turn 18 during the year may finish it.
pay_detail: Unpaid. One-time $50 fee after acceptance, which can be waived for those who qualify.
duration: One year, June 1 to May 31, at least 45 hours
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications are closed. The museum expects to post information on the 2027-28 program in February 2027.
how_to_apply: Submit an online application, an essay written by the teen, and two reference forms. Selected applicants are invited to interview. Contact: FYI@FernbankMuseum.org or 404-929-6360.
notes: Described as very competitive; teens who are not accepted are encouraged to reapply the next year.
